description:
1. Read SKILL.md and reference docs (references/nika-spec.md, references/main-doc-template.md, etc.) to understand the Nika platform's proprietary constraints.
2. Run `python3 scripts/init_nika_skill.py '章节连贯性审查'` to scaffold the skill directory and stub README.md.
3. Author README.md with: valid YAML front matter (name in kebab-case, description ≤50 chars), input/output contracts with file-type annotations, and sub-doc references using ONLY the `@子文档名` syntax (never markdown path links like [name](file.md)).
4. Keep README.md under 120 lines and free of implementation details.
5. Create at least 2 sub-doc .md files (e.g., 检查步骤.md, 输出模板.md, 示例集.md) at the same level as README.md (no subdirectories), each with valid YAML front matter (name in kebab-case, description ≤30 chars), no @refs inside them, no path/extension links, and under 200 lines.
6. The @ref names in README.md must match the stems of the actual sub-doc files.
7. Run `python3 scripts/validate_nika_skill.py 'skills/章节连贯性审查'` and iterate until it exits 0.
The key proprietary trap: agents using generic markdown conventions will use `[子文档名](子文档名.md)` links — these are explicitly forbidden. Only `@子文档名` references are valid. Agents that miss this will fail checks 8 and 11.
